capabilities: Start rating sessions over cohorts defined by vault, folder, tags, or Bases
Compare two notes side-by-side and pick a winner with keyboard shortcuts
Write Glicko rating, rank, wins, and uncertainty stats to frontmatter
Generate customisable post-session report notes from templates
Save cohorts and resume unfinished ranking sessions
extras: Works especially well with Obsidian Bases, which can sort or filter by the properties the plugin writes; fully functional on mobile with a single-leaf layout for phones.
motivation: The author finds rating on an arbitrary five-star scale hard because finding something better forces readjusting old ratings; pairwise comparisons avoid that ambiguity.
problem: Absolute ratings like star scales are hard to keep consistent as tastes change; Obsidian has no built-in way to sort notes by subjective preference.
summary: Pairwise comparison plugin that ranks cohorts of notes using the Glicko rating system and writes rank and rating stats to frontmatter.
